Requirement: The system shall allow a user to access, create, edit, or revise a document in Enlil
The system shall clearly indicate the state of the document being viewed

The system shall display the following default columns on the landing page for the documents list: Document ID, 
Revision (major only), 
Document Title, 
Document Type, 
Document Owner, 
the associated AR ID, 
Document Status, and 
Effective Date 
(this list defines content, not column header names)
The system should provide a mechanism to export the Document List (e.g. to a .csv format)
The system shall only display documents in the documents list (e.g. records can be found in their respective modules or in the records list)
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed Document List for each of the columns displayed on the landing page
The system shall default the Document List filter to display released documents when starting a new Enlil session
The system shall maintain Document List filter settings during an Enlil session when navigating away from and back to the Document List landing page
The system shall default to the Document List being sorted by most recent edited first
The system shall provide a mechanism to clear all Document List filters
The system shall display the number of documents displayed that match the filter settings
The system shall allow the user to open a document from within the Document List
The system should display the description of the document when the mouse hovers over the document title in the Document List
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to create a document from the Document List landing page
The system shall allow a user to revise a document that is in the Released state

The system shall provide the following editable document attributes when creating or revising a document: (Document Title, Document Description, Document Type, Document Revision Stage, Reference, Training Required, Attachments, Users (document access privileges), Groups (document access privileges), Document Owner Assignment)
The system shall allow the user to edit document ID, when creating a document.
The system shall allow the document owner to add one or more references to a document in draft state
The system shall allow the document owner to remove references to a document in draft state
The system shall allow the document owner to upload one or more  attachments to a document in draft state
The system support attachments of multiple types.
The system shall allow the document owner to upload multiple documents at once
The system shall notify the user if a document upload failure occurs
